# SUPERMEGA Experiments
> Weekly visual experiments by SUPERMEGA Design (https://supermega.design). Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step.

## Colour Well
- [Open the instrument](https://experiments.supermega.design/colour-well/): concentric shapes stepping through a colour ramp, the convergence point pulled off its axis
- The nesting is a choice of model, not a scale factor — equal-band inset (what the classic posters actually do; inner rectangles go tall) or similar-scaled Albers copies — and the default cobalt configuration reproduces a measured reference frame, ramp provably HSL rather than RGB
- Rings are world-space Path2D fills; Clip mode accumulates each ring's path as a clip region so the well nests strictly even when the centre drifts
- [Seed prompt](https://experiments.supermega.design/colour-well/seed-prompt.txt): a self-contained prompt for coding agents — paste it into your agent to rebuild and adapt this system

## Bubble Writer
- [Open the instrument](https://experiments.supermega.design/bubble-writer/): bubble lettering generated as geometry, written into a frame one letter at a time
- The letterform is an operation, not a typeface — an exact signed distance transform of a thin glyph, contoured by marching squares at a true offset distance, then relaxed like a balloon under surface tension and internal pressure
- Credited study of Tracy Ma's bubble-letter animation for Blonded (2019); the placement behaviour was recovered from the published source of the NYT's Gen X Is A Mess (2019). Their letters are hand-drawn, these are generated, and none of their artwork or code is used
- [Seed prompt](https://experiments.supermega.design/bubble-writer/seed-prompt.txt): a self-contained prompt for coding agents — paste it into your agent to rebuild and adapt this system

## Computer Graphics and Art
- [Open the collection](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76/): sixteen instruments derived from Computer Graphics and Art, vol. 1 no. 2, May 1976
- Each one is a clean-room study written from the issue's published descriptions — no scans ship, no source lines are traced
- Instruments: [Ordinal Fifteen](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-ordinal-fifteen/), [Barbadillo Modules](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-barbadillo-modules/), [Cubic Limit](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-cubic-limit/), [Cube Variations](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-cube-variations/), [Sykora Matrix](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-sykora-matrix/), [Nine-Square Variations](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-nine-square/), [Cube Series Projection](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-cube-series/), [Kubus Permutator](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-kubus-permutator/), [Kawano Mosaic](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-kawano-mosaic/), [Random Squares](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-random-squares/), [Text Image Matrix](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-text-image-matrix/), [Harmonic Story](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-harmonic-story/), [Colored Matrix Growth](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-colored-matrix/), [Luminous Sculpture](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-luminous-sculpture/), [Tangent Polygon Trails](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-tangent-polygons/), [Concentric Rosettes](https://experiments.supermega.design/cga76-concentric-rosettes/)
- Every instrument ships a seed-prompt.txt — paste it into a coding agent to rebuild and adapt that system

## Pixel Garden Lab
- [Open](https://experiments.supermega.design/pixel-garden/): the live tool
- [Seed prompt](https://experiments.supermega.design/pixel-garden/seed-prompt.txt): a self-contained prompt for coding agents — paste it into your agent to rebuild and adapt this system
- [Engine](https://experiments.supermega.design/pixel-garden/core/pixel-core.js): dependency-free source, with [sprites](https://experiments.supermega.design/pixel-garden/core/sprites.js)

Free to use in your projects; a link back is appreciated.
